title: Climb
description: Allows players to climb over everything
body:
# Climb
Required Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/kotlinplugins
- Allows players to climb over all blocks by introducing smooth fly-like mechanic - very cool for clutching!!
- The purpose of this plugin is to create new experience for movement, parkours, combat etc. 
- Check out other plugins: https://modrinth.com/user/Winlyps
